notes: This repository contains data associated with the DaNuMa 2024 summer school 'machine learning in animal science'. Apart from data of our own research group, the repository contains data from previous publications [1, 2] that has been modified for teaching purposes. References [1] Bergamini, L., Pini, S., Simoni, A., Vezzani, R., Calderara, S., Eath, R. B., & Fisher, R. B. (2021). Extracting accurate long-term behavior changes from a large pig dataset. In 16th International Joint Conference on Computer Vision, Imaging and Computer Graphics Theory and Applications, VISIGRAPP 2021 (pp. 524-533). SciTePress. [2] Psota, E. T., Mittek, M., Pérez, L. C., Schmidt, T., & Mote, B. (2019). Multi-pig part detection and association with a fully-convolutional network. Sensors, 19(4), 852.
